responsibilities: Build and maintain reusable data models, macros, and semantic layers in dbt and BigQuery
Develop staging, intermediate, and mart models following clear data modeling principles
Implement data quality tests, freshness checks, and documentation
Improve the lineage, ownership, and discoverability of our most important tables
Strengthen our semantic layer and ensure that metric definitions are consistent
Identify and remove duplicated, obsolete, or deprecated datasets and content
Optimize queries and models for reliability, performance, and cost
Build reusable data assets that can be leveraged by Data Analysts across different business domains
Lead enablement by mentoring analysts and training them on dbt, Looker, governance, and metric definitions
Partner on the data platform roadmap across GCP, BigQuery, Argo, dbt, and Looker
Contribute to keeping our data stack clean, reliable, and easy to maintain
Participate in code reviews and help define analytics engineering standards
Discuss and validate data contracts with the rest of the Engineering team
Collaborate with Data Analysts, Data Engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver trusted and actionable data

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour: quality tests, governance, lineage, data contracts and "trusted datasets" dominate, and the only speed phrase ("scaling rapidly") is company description.

evidence.domain_risk_explanation: BNPL fintech implies high, but the responsibilities carry no financial-reporting or regulatory language, so the tie-breaker gives moderate.

evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mid: an existing dbt/BigQuery/Looker stack and a six-analyst team to "rebuild and standardize", not a first data hire.
evidence.jd_authorship: Develop staging, intermediate, and mart models following clear data modeling principles
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Hiring manager: bullets name the layering, tools and practices precisely ("medallion-inspired approach", "GCP, BigQuery, Argo, dbt, and Looker").

evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Internal data: the main audience is the analyst community and self-service consumers ("leveraged by Data Analysts").

evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI enabler: the candidate strengthens the semantic layer and metadata so conversational (AI) analytics can consume it.
evidence.testing_framing: Implement data quality tests, freshness checks, and documentation

evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Fix/scale: verbs are improve, strengthen, standardize and remove across existing foundations.
